source_citation: Jacquemyn, Micheneau, Roberts & Pailler (2005). Elevational gradients of species diversity, breeding system and floral traits of orchid species on Reunion Island. Journal of Biogeography 32:1751-1761.
source_table: Appendix 1, named species row, Breeding system column
review_note: Methods p.1753 describe bud-stage bagging for each species and subsequent fruiting. Appendix footnote p.1761 defines CP as requiring pollinators for fruit set. The explicit negative experimental classification supports absence of autonomous fruiting in studied conditions, not absence inferred from a blank. No self-incompatibility or outcrossing mating-system assignment.
limitations: Population-scoped categorical outcome; per-species experimental sample size and raw fruit counts are not reported. Does not establish universal biological inability or SI. Genus training disabled. Pollination-syndrome letters are not assigned as traits.
